body:
## What it does

Watches official channels from xAI, Anthropic, Google, OpenAI, DeepSeek and six more, and sends a single verified digest rather than a running feed of rumour. It runs on a schedule rather than waiting to be asked.

## Before you install

Open the share link and read the instructions it carries before you add it. @GuleidAmina shared this one publicly, and adding it copies the setup into your own account rather than giving you access to theirs.
